items.title: A Unified Framework for Probability Estimation of Data-Dependent Events
items.authors: Vitaly Feldman, Satyen Kale, Vinod Raman et al.
items.abstract: We study the general problem of estimating $D(\dde(S))$, the probability that an unknown distribution $D$ assigns to an event determined by a sample $S$ of $n$ i.i.d.\ draws from $D$ through a known mapping $\dde$. items.title: CONSORT: Uncertainty-Constrained Multi-Robot Planning for Cooperative Localization in GPS-Denied Environments

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.authors: Kehong Gong, Xiaoxu Zheng, Guanli Hou et al.
